use: Broad European goal-score context only. Keep each competition separate. Never infer shots, passes, player roles, duels or tempo from goal-only rows.

method.seasonSelection: Openfootball Europe files labelled 2024-25 or calendar 2024, plus UEFA 2024-25 Champions/Europa/Conference League main stages and qualifiers.
method.scoreField: Use generated JSON score.ft as full-time/after-extra-time total; exclude score.p shootout kicks; include score.et match scores where supplied.
method.variance: Unbiased sample variance using n−1 across the listed match rows, and across home+away team-match rows.
method.eligibleCoverage: For broad contextual summaries only, include domestic rows whose scored matches / declared matches coverage is at least 95%; all rows and coverage are kept for transparency.
limitations: This pinned repository snapshot does not include every league, division or domestic cup in all UEFA associations; per-file coverage exposes gaps and is not described as a complete census.
Many files are score-only. Goals do not validate shots, passes, possession, duels, running distance or the match decision process.
The 2024–25 season is used for cross-league context, while calendar-year 2024 is used where the source schedules a European league by calendar year. These are not a single season boundary.
UEFA qualifiers, UEFA main competitions, domestic leagues and domestic cups remain distinct distributions. Cup ties are each a match; shootout kicks are not goals.

competitions.scoreScope: Text parser uses stated full-time or after-extra-time scores; shootout kicks excluded. Penalty ties without an explicit after-extra-time score may be omitted.
